title: 第1358章  光阴之外(终)
content_zh:
岁月流逝。
望古已过三百年。
.这三百年里，望古安宁，天地间再没有了异质，而望古的神灵也在三百年前，随着许青的归来，大都选择了离去。
留下的不多。
整个第九星环，在神尊失踪之后，神灵体系已消散。
唯有上荒还在。
祂依旧是高悬在望古之上，那完整的脸，始终闭目。
至于许青所熟悉的故人，在这三百年里，也各有自身的机遇与造化，其中七爷那里，因其修行功法的特殊，且已到自身修行的尽头，于是他选择了与以往一样…重入轮回！
只不过这一次，他并非走入望古轮回!
他去了厚土，要在厚土转生！这是他的道!作出这个决定后，他告诉许青！
“我们，未来还会相见！”
许青自不会阻拦，默默点头后，他亲自送七爷去了厚土，望着对方消散在了厚土星环，他深深一拜！
随后，许青去了煌天！
在那里，他望着依旧沉唾的大师兄!
以许青如今的修为与阅历，他对于大师兄的来历，已多多少少有了方向！
与原始母星无关，大师兄…应与神明脐带相关！
许青轻语，转身离开了煌天，回了朝霞山！
继续他已进行了三百年的境界迈进!
仙尊这个境界，对许青而言，已经触摸到了!
双子星的融合，就可真正的归一，也是仙尊之路！

但所需的时间，无比漫长！
不过许青不急！
甚至这种修行，他也并非完全沉浸，而是以平静的心，默默的体会人生，与紫玄一同经历时光变迁，春夏秋冬！
一年一年！
若干年后的一天!
朝霞山上，许青正含笑的听着紫玄述说当年的相遇，忽然心有所动，抬头望向苍育!
下一瞬，他还在朝霞山，但另一个他，已出现在了天幕之上，出现在了那高悬的上荒之面前！
望着闭日的上荒，许青盘膝坐下，默默等待！
直至数十息后!
这千年来，一动不动的上荒，其双眼缓缓睁开!
不再是如当年般一只猩红，一只虚无！
睁开的双眼内，透出清明，望向许青！
“你醒了！”许青平静开口！
上荒沉默，半响后，整个望古传出滔天巨响!
若此刻从望古之外的星空中，看向望古，可以清晰的看到上荒蜈蚣一般，缠绕整个望古的那条脊骨了，此刻竟在舒展。
刹那间，就彻底的舒展开来，不再是缠绕，而是在舒展之余，飞速的缩小!
连同上荒那完整的脸，一切的一切，在须臾里，仿佛消失不见。
这一天，这一刻，望古众生都心神翻腾至极!
因为，他们祖祖辈辈记忆中，高悬天际的残面，消失了。
而苍育上，许青的面前，多出了一道身影！

一身黑色的长袍，一头黑色的苌发，盘膝坐在了许青的前方，抬起了头，露出了一张与许青相似的脸！
“这些岁月，我的出现，给你以及你的世界，添麻烦了，这是我命运的业火，也将伴随我的命运，一直存在！”
“故我成神之日，发下神誓所有因我而陨的生灵，都将在未来，与我一同辉煌。”
这身影，轻声开口!
许青深深的看了眼面前的身影！
“我该称呼你紫青，还是上荒?”
“我也不知我是谁，可能是上荒，也可能是紫青，更可能是二者的结合意识，但我更喜欢紫青这个名字！”
“紫青望着许青，笑了笑!”
“那么，你现在是否可以告诉我，我的来历?”许青平静问询！
紫青目中露出一抹深邃之意！
“你真的想知道？”许青点头!
紫青沉默，半响抬头，望向远方的虚无!
声音好似从岁月而来，回荡在许青耳边!
你的融合，已到了尽头，或许随时可以完成上行星环的最后一步!
“而无论是神尊，还是你所走的仙尊之道，其实都没有前后境界的区分，只有所感悟权之强弱，某种程度…到了，就是到了!”
“这是上行的极限!”
但不是我们以及众多先者的极限，按照诡界的最原始记载，我们的境界之后，还存在了一个更高的层次!”
“诡界，将其称之为诡明!”
而如今的上行，将其称之为神明！
“至于你们修士，在未来也有对其的特殊称呼，叫做希夷，也是道的本体！

说到这里，紫青目光从远方收回，落在了许青身上！
许青看着紫青，若有所思，缓缓开口！
“想要达到你所说的这个层次，唯有离开上行，走神明脐带。”
紫青闻言，点了点头!
神明脐带这个名宁，起源于诡界，在曾经诡界占据的时代，那里叫做异诡脐带！
“是离开上行的唯一路，走上那条路，才可追求更高境界！”
而我当年在神明脐带内，走到了最深处！
这个过程，也是我的晋升，亦或者说，每一个走神明脐带者，都在踏入的一刻，开始了自我的晋升！
“如果有人能彻底走出，便可成为神明！”
而我，只差一步！
紫青轻叹！
“与我有关?”许青忽然开口！
紫青目光更为深邃，缓缓的点了点头！
“在神明脐带的最深处，我看见了一条苌廊，那里有众多的门，每一个门，都代表一位神尊或者诡尊。”
这世间，每多一尊，那里的门，就会多一扇！
许青听到这里，双日一凝！
紫青声音继续！
“在门上，刻下自己的名字，推开门，走出去就可真正晋升！”
而那条苌廊的尽头还存在了一张座椅，上面坐着一个人，他的手中，拿着一枚紫色的水晶，身边陪伴的，是一副女子的骸骨，以及一条枯菱的蓝色蠕虫，都已死亡很久!
他孤独的坐在那里，身上弥漫了古老，似乎可以追溯至诡界我不知他是谁，但我看见他的那一刻，脑海浮现提出了两个字，司阈。”

他已频死，而我为全盛，他阻我刻名，于是我与他之间，展开了一场生死战。
“那一战，我输了，只剩下残躯逃回，而他也没有真正的赢。”
“因为，他坐化作在了神明脐带的最深处!”
并于坐化前，通过我的回归之力，送出来一个可能！
“甚至我如今去回忆，他阻拦我，或许就是因其自身在我之前，已是尽头，而我的出现，给了他希望，所以在我失败后，他没有斩杀，而是刻意的放我走，就为了带走他的那一个可能!”
“那个可能，与我的可能交融，故而一同，去了煌天的原始母星！”
“然后，成为了你！”
紫青望向许青!
许青沉默，这番话语，在他的心中掀起涟漪！
他想到了自己的紫色水晶，想到了灵魂深处的长廊，想到了那个座椅!
最重要的，是紫青口中的女子骸骨与蓝色蠕出许久!
紫青站起了身!
我既苏醒，要继续走神明脐带！
“这一次，不会有人阻止我了，而你要送我吗?”紫青笑着开口！
许青闻言，缓缓的点了点头!
神明脐带，可以存在于上行星环的任何一处!
但要将其开启则需上行意志的自我敞开!
这种敞开，是上行意志所不愿！
可对紫青而言，这不是问题，当他选择在第八星环走神明脐带的那一刻，第八星环的意志，自行震颤间，主动为池敞开了自身!
释放出了一个巨人的漩涡!

那是神明脐带的入口！
而紫肯的离去之事，祂并未隐藏，故而离开的那一天！
整个上行星环所有的神尊，都出现了！
包括了巨兽以及黑塔!
祂们明白，若上荒欲出手，祂们来与不来，都是一个结局，如此不如坦然面对！
其中，还包括了第五星环的仙尊，以及其旁的柏大师!
他们两个，与所有的神尊一同，注视着紫青，注视着许青！
望着他们，走到神明脐带入口处的紫青，忽然开口！
“你们，有愿意与我同行者吗！”
他神声音一出，四周所有的神尊，无不心神波澜！
神明脐带的危险，他们心知肚明，但这是迈向更高层次的路!
能走到神尊这个境界者，都有自身的追求与气魄!
若存在可能，自不会甘心境界的止步!
所以，这是一次机会，最终！有一些神尊，处于自身不同的需求与思绪，选择了与紫青一同，走入到了神明脐带内!
但更多的神尊，并无这般，他们与许青一同，目送这场离开！
许青的目光，一直到那神明脐带的漩涡消失，才慢慢收回！
他没有看见紫青所说的长廊!
而众尊，也各自离去!
到了神尊仙尊这个层次，彼此不会轻易出手，而神灵与修士这二条路，与神明脐带面前，似乎也不算什么了!
不过第五星环的仙尊与柏大师，在临走前，与许青有所叙旧!

而后，回归所在星环！
至于许青也回到了朝霞山，继续听着紫玄说着当年他们相遇的往事，笑容柔和！
时光，不断的流淌!
岁月，无声无息的走过！
光阴的故事，还在持续的发生，一件件，一桩桩，有新的修士崛起，有老的修士饮恨!
神灵亦是如此！
周而复始，仿佛亘古以来，就没有怎么改变过轨迹！
至于神灵脐带，在之后的这些时光中，又开启了数次!
每一次，都有神尊选择离去，追寻神明。
但没有人知晓，当年的紫青他们，是否成功，也不知晓后面进入神明脐带的那些神尊，是否还活着!
上行之外，就好似光阴之外，不可探究！
直至，这一年！
三月，惊蛰！
二牛醒了！
他苏醒的一刻，整个煌天都在轰鸣，声响之大，伴随着他的豪言与笑声，回荡望古！
“小阿青，你大师兄我醒了，现在的我，可比以前更厉害，那个什么紫青，我来帮你弄他。”
“还有残面，我……”二牛神情狂傲，一边开口，一边身体冲破了煌天，出现在了望的天空上，抬手一指苍育那原本残面所在的地方！
可下一瞬，他眼睛睁大，声音戛然而止，呆呆的看着空旷的天幕！
半响后，他飞速的转头，目光在天空上找了好几圈！
“什么情况，残面呢?”

“大师兄！”许青的声音，在二牛这里迷茫时，从虚无传来!
接着天空波澜，许青拉着紫玄的手，显现而出，笑着望向二牛！
二牛呆呆的看着许青，随后倒吸口气!
他在许青身上，感知到了一般远超神主的气息，那气息……
“神尊?仙尊?”
“这这是什么情况，我怎么睡了一觉，一切都变了!…天空的残面没了?”紫青也没了?小阿青怎么成了尊?”二牛茫然!
许青笑了，声音温和!
“大师兄，我等你很久了，我要走神明脐带，你…愿意与我一同吗?”
神明脐带，在这无尽的时光里，在当年紫青离去后，第七次开启了!
这一次，开启在了第九星环！
仙尊与柏大师，来此送别，他们没有选择走!
而是决定留在上行星环!
于是在那神明脐带的入口旋涡外，许青带着紫玄，与二牛一同站在那里，望着仙尊，望着柏大师!
柏大师微微点头！
“还记得我当年的话吗，天地是万物众生的客舍，光阴是古往今来的过客…当年，你送我，今日，我送你！”
“只要不死，終会再见！”许青闻言，向着柏大师，深深一拜!
随后，他回头看向望古！
抬手一捞，将记忆里无数人的真灵捞出，包含自己的父母！
做完这些，他目中露出坚定，看向紫玄与二牛!
紫玄轻柔的点头被许青保护在内!

而二牛化作一条蓝色蠕虫，趴在了许青的肩膀上，传出叫嚣之声!
“走啦，不就是条破脐带吗，进去看看里面有没有什么好吃的，许青闻言笑了笑，不再迟疑，向着前方的漩涡，迈出最后一步！踏入神明脐带!追求更高层次！希夷。”
“我不知这是第几次，但这一次，我一定可以成功。”
大结局!
content_en:
Years pass.
Three hundred years have passed since ancient times.
.In the past three hundred years, Wanggu has been peaceful, and there is no difference between heaven and earth. Most of Wanggu's gods also chose to leave with the return of Xu Qing three hundred years ago.
Not much is left.
In the entire ninth star ring, after the disappearance of the god, the god system has dissipated.
Only Shanghuang is still there.
He is still hanging high above Wang Gu, with his intact face and eyes always closed.
As for the old friends Xu Qing is familiar with, they each had their own opportunities and fortunes in the past three hundred years. Among them, Qiye, because of his special practice and reaching the end of his own practice, chose to do the same as before... reentering reincarnation!
Only this time, he did not enter the ancient reincarnation!
He went to the thick earth and was going to be reincarnated in the thick earth! This is his way! After making this decision, he told Xu Qing!
"We will meet again in the future!"
Xu Qing would not stop him. After nodding silently, he personally sent Master Qi to Houtu. Watching him disappear into the ring of Houtu, he bowed deeply!
Later, Xu Qing went to Huangtian!
There, he looked at his senior brother who was still salivating!
With Xu Qing's current cultivation and experience, he has more or less a clue as to the origin of his senior brother!
It has nothing to do with the original home planet, Big Brother...should be related to the umbilical cord of the gods!
Xu Qing whispered, turned around, left Huangtian, and returned to Chaoxia Mountain!
Continuing the advancement he has been making for three hundred years!
Xu Qing has already touched the realm of Immortal Lord!
The fusion of the twin stars can truly unite, which is also the path of the Immortal!
But the time required is extremely long!
But Xu Qing is not in a hurry!
Even in this kind of practice, he was not completely immersed in it, but with a calm heart, he silently experienced life and experienced the changes of time with Zixuan, spring, summer, autumn and winter!
Year after year!
One day some years later!
On Chaoxia Mountain, Xu Qing was smiling as he listened to Zixuan describing their encounter that year. Suddenly his heart moved and he looked up at Cang Yu!
The next moment, he was still in Zhaoxia Mountain, but another him had appeared on the sky, in front of the high-hanging Shanghuangzhi!
Looking at the closed sun in Shanghuang, Xu Qing sat cross-legged and waited silently!
Until dozens of breaths later!
For these thousands of years, Shanghuang had remained motionless, and his eyes slowly opened!
There is no longer one scarlet and one nothingness like before!
The eyes that opened were clear and clear, looking at Xu Qing!
"You're awake!" Xu Qing said calmly!
Shanghuang was silent, and after a while, a loud noise was heard throughout Wanggu!
If you look at Wanggu from the starry sky outside Wanggu at this moment, you can clearly see that the spine that wraps around Wanggu like a centipede in the wilderness is actually stretching at this moment.
In an instant, it completely stretched out, no longer entangled, but rapidly shrinking while stretching!
Along with Shanghuang's complete face, everything seemed to disappear in a moment.
On this day and at this moment, all sentient beings are extremely upset!
Because, in the memory of their ancestors for generations, the remaining face hanging high in the sky has disappeared.
On Cang Yu, in front of Xu Qing, there was an additional figure!
Wearing a black robe and black stubble hair, he sat cross-legged in front of Xu Qing, raised his head, and revealed a face similar to Xu Qing's!
"In these years, my appearance has caused trouble for you and your world. This is the karma of my destiny, and it will always exist with my destiny!"
"Therefore, on the day I become a god, I swear that all living beings who die because of me will be glorious with me in the future."
This figure spoke softly!
Xu Qing took a deep look at the figure in front of him!
"Should I call you Ziqing or Shanghuang?"
"I don't know who I am. It may be Shanghuang, or Zi Qing, or more likely a combination of the two, but I like the name Zi Qing better!"
"Zi Qing looked at Xu Qing and smiled!"
"So, can you tell me now?Me, my origin?" Xu Qing asked calmly!
There is a profound meaning in the purple eyes!
"You really want to know? "Xu Qing nodded!
Zi Qing was silent, raised her head for a while, and looked into the void in the distance!
The sound seemed to come from the years, echoing in Xu Qing's ears!
Your fusion has reached its end, and you may be able to complete the final step to the planetary ring at any time!
"And whether you are a god or the path of an immortal you are following, there is actually no distinction between the front and back realms. There is only the strength and weakness of the perceived power. To a certain extent... when it is reached, it is reached!"
“This is the limit of upside!”
But it is not the limit of us and many predecessors. According to the most original records of the Strange World, there is a higher level after our realm!"
"In the mysterious world, call it the mysterious world!"
And now the upswing calls it a god!
"As for you monks, they will also have a special name for them in the future, called Xiyi, who is also the essence of Tao!
Having said this, Zi Qing withdrew his gaze from a distance and landed on Xu Qing!
Xu Qing looked at Zi Qing, thoughtfully, and spoke slowly!
“To reach the level you mentioned, the only way is to leave the upward path and walk on the umbilical cord of the gods. "
Zi Qing heard this and nodded!
The name Ning of the Divine Umbilical Cord originated from the Strange World. In the era when the Strange World once occupied it, it was called the Weird Umbilical Cord!
“It is the only way to leave and go up. Only by walking on that road can you pursue a higher realm! "
And I went to the deepest point in the umbilical cord of the gods!
This process is also my promotion, or in other words, every person who walks the umbilical cord of the gods begins his own promotion at the moment of entering!
“If someone can escape completely, he can become a god! "
And I am only one step away!
Zi Qing sighed!
"Is it related to me?" Xu Qing suddenly said!
Zi Qing's eyes became deeper and he nodded slowly!
"In the deepest part of the umbilical cord of the gods, I saw a corridor with many doors, each door representing a god or a deceitful god. "
Every time there is one more statue in this world, there will be one more door there!
Xu Qing was stunned when he heard this!
Ziqing’s voice continues!
“Write your name on the door, open the door, and walk out to truly be promoted! "
And there is a seat at the end of the corridor, and there is a person sitting on it. He is holding a purple crystal in his hand. Accompanying him are the skeleton of a woman and a withered blue worm, all of which have been dead for a long time!
He sat there alone, his body filled with antiquity, which seemed to be traceable back to the mysterious world. I didn't know who he was, but the moment I saw him, two words came to my mind, Si Shu. "
He had died frequently, but I was prosperous, and he prevented me from carving my name, so a life-and-death battle began between me and him.
"In that battle, I lost and escaped with only my broken body, but he didn't really win either."
"Because he sat in the deepest part of the umbilical cord of the gods!"
And before passing away, through the power of my return, I will give you a possibility!
"Even now I think about it, maybe he stopped me because he was at the end before me, and my appearance gave him hope. So after I failed, he didn't kill me, but deliberately let me go, just to take away his possibility!"
"That possibility blended with my possibility, so we went to Huangtian's original home star together!"
"Then, it became you!"
Zi Qing looks at Xu Qing!
Xu Qing was silent, these words caused ripples in his heart!
He thought of his purple crystal, the corridor deep in his soul, and that seat!
The most important thing is that the woman's skeleton and blue squirted out of Zi Qing's mouth for a long time!
Zi Qing stood up!
Now that I'm awake, I want to continue walking on the umbilical cord of God!
"This time, no one will stop me, and you want to send me off?" Zi Qing said with a smile!
Xu Qing heard this,He nodded slowly!
The divine umbilical cord can exist anywhere in the upper planetary ring!
But to turn it on requires the self-opening of the upward will!
This kind of openness is what the upward will does not want!
But for Zi Qing, this was not a problem. The moment he chose to walk on the umbilical cord of the gods in the eighth star ring, the will of the eighth star ring trembled on its own and took the initiative to open itself to Chi!
A giant vortex was released!
That is the entrance to the umbilical cord of the gods!
And He didn't hide Ziken's departure, so he left on that day!
All the gods in the entire upper planet ring appeared!
Including Behemoth and Black Tower!
They understand that if Shanghuang wants to take action, the outcome will be the same whether they come or not, so it is better to face it calmly!
Among them, they also include the Immortal Lord of the Fifth Star Ring and Master Bai next to him!
The two of them, together with all the gods, looked at Zi Qing and Xu Qing!
Looking at them, Zi Qing walked to the entrance of the god's umbilical cord and suddenly spoke!
"Do you have anyone willing to go with me?"
